name: Admin Toolbar Background Color
description: Changes the admin toolbar background color (e.g. as a per-environment indicator).
project_description:
The "Admin Toolbar BG Color" module allows administrators to easily customise the background color of the Drupal Admin Toolbar through a simple configuration interface. This module provides a color picker to select the desired background color, ensuring a more personalised and visually cohesive admin experience.

 Features 
 The "Admin Toolbar BG Color" module allows administrators to easily customize the background color of the Drupal Admin Toolbar through a simple configuration interface. This module provides a color picker to select the desired background color, ensuring a more personalized and visually cohesive admin experience.

 Post-Installation 
 To configure go to admin/config/administration/at-bgcolor

 Additional Requirements 
 Utilises the color_field module for the color picker functionality.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/color_field
